claimBoundary: This profile qualifies provisional complete-input scan generations for the narrow package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 backend. It does not qualify a network-suspending DecodeSession or a public production backend.

ImageCraft must reuse one admitted RGB output backing across every scan callback; the evidence harness may copy generations externally, but those copies are not decoder-owned retained payload and do not widen the product operation charge.

For every completed scan, ImageCraft RGB must equal pinned libjpeg-turbo buffered-image output byte-for-byte with do_block_smoothing disabled. This isolates entropy/progression/IDCT/chroma reconstruction correctness from libjpeg's optional progressive block-smoothing preview policy.

Generated cases cross the width-4/width-5 box-to-fancy h2v2 branch, the height-16/height-17 cross-iMCU context boundary, content/quality variation and restart markers. Retained cases add real 7/9/10-scan scripts.

Passing this profile does not imply that no-smoothing previews are perceptually optimal. Default libjpeg block smoothing is a separate policy/mechanism frontier and must be studied independently before claiming preview-quality parity.
